title: Muhleveleri wa Nsuku eMananga
intro: Anakanya hi kampa leyikulu ya mananga hi nkarhi wa ku rindza ni ku nga tiyiseki. Murhangeri lonkulu u fambile a ya hlangana na Vukwembu, a siya vaaki lava hisekelaka nchumu lowu vonakaka ku khomelela eka wona. Eka ku yimanyana koloko loku nga tshamisekangiki, xifaniso lexi khorwisaka xi ya emahlweni hi switshembiso leswi voningaka ni xivumbiwa xa vutlhari lexi vonakaka xi hanya.
clues: A ndzi ri exikarhi ka lava sukeke aEgipta na Musa, va vona lwandle ri hambanile leswaku hi baleka.
Ndzi hlalerile loko murhangeri wa hina a ya entshaveni vusiku bya makume mune ku ya kuma nkongomiso.
Ndzi hlengelete swikhaviso eka vanhu kutani ndzi swi vumba hi mavoko ya mina.
Ndzi endle rhole leri humesaka mpfumawulo wo rhurhumela, kutani ndzi vitana vanhu leswaku va ta eka rona.
Ndzi teke voko ra ntshuri eka gondzo ra murhumiwa ndzi ri hoxa eka leswi ndzi swi endleke.
Ndzi langutane na Musa kutani ndzi gweviwa ku vula leswaku 'u ndzi khumbi' ndzi tshama ndzi hambanile, na nhlengeletano leyi tshembisiweke ku avanyisa.

arabic: قَالَ فَٱذْهَبْ فَإِنَّ لَكَ فِى ٱلْحَيَوٰةِ أَن تَقُولَ لَا مِسَاسَ ۖ وَإِنَّ لَكَ مَوْعِدًۭا لَّن تُخْلَفَهُۥ ۖ وَٱنظُرْ إِلَىٰٓ إِلَـٰهِكَ ٱلَّذِى ظَلْتَ عَلَيْهِ عَاكِفًۭا ۖ لَّنُحَرِّقَنَّهُۥ ثُمَّ لَنَنسِفَنَّهُۥ فِى ٱلْيَمِّ نَسْفًا
verse: [Moses] said, "Then go. And indeed, it is [decreed] for you in [this] life to say, 'No contact.' And indeed, you have an appointment [in the Hereafter] you will not fail to keep. And look at your 'god' to which you remained devoted. We will surely burn it and blow it [i.e., its ashes] into the sea with a blast. (20:97)
